blocks.orig: Exploring all that Tanzania has to offer is a dream for many. From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: Many people dream of discovering everything Tanzania has to offer. Whether it is an epic Tanzania safari in search of Africa’s Big Five, a Kilimanjaro climb or time on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: you will find it all in Tanzania. The good news is that Your Tanzania Trip can put together a custom made itinerary that fits all your wishes.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?
blocks.html: For some inspiration, take a look at our most popular itineraries. Most of our guests like to round off their exciting safari with a few relaxing days on one of Zanzibar’s most beautiful beaches. Does that appeal to you too?

blocks.orig: Whether you choose one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or prefer to customize your journey, we are here to assist you. Come aboard and get ready to explore Tanzania at your own pace, exactly the way you like it!
blocks.html: Whether you go for one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or would rather shape your own journey, we are happy to help. Join us and get ready to discover Tanzania at your own pace, just the way you want!

blocks.orig: When you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport our Your Tanzania Trip guide is there waiting for you. He then drops you off at your hotel, where you can relax from your flight.
blocks.html: On arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, your Your Tanzania Trip guide is already waiting. He takes you to your hotel so you can rest after the flight.

blocks.orig: Preparation for your climb: You meet your guide before the start of your climb, where he briefs you and offers advice on what to wear, what to pack, and other important tips to make your climb as comfortable as possible.
blocks.html: Getting ready for your climb: Before the climb starts you meet your guide for a briefing, with advice on clothing, packing and other useful tips to keep you as comfortable as possible on the mountain.

blocks.orig: Your adventure starts at your hotel, where your driver picks you up and drives you to Londorossi Gate (on the west side). You then go to Lemosho trailhead for lunch and begin the climb. This easy walk through dense rainforest lasts 3 to 4 hours and offers the chance to spot various animals, including buffalo and monkeys. After a narrow path and a few steep sections, you reach Big Tree Camp, where you spend the night.
blocks.html: The adventure begins at your hotel, where your driver collects you for the journey to Londorossi Gate (on the west side). From there you continue to the Lemosho trailhead for lunch and start climbing. This gentle walk through thick rainforest takes 3 to 4 hours, and you may see a variety of animals along the way, such as buffalo and monkeys. Following a narrow trail and a few steep stretches, you arrive at Big Tree Camp for the night.

blocks.orig: This morning you leave the forest to enter an environment of meadow heather and volcanic rock. You ascend and descend through the lush hills below the Shira Plateau, the third of Kilimanjaro’s volcanic peaks. Upon reaching the edge of the plateau, the long 5-6 hour hike ends, and the trail becomes easier. You then arrive at Shira Camp, where you spend the night enjoying an incredible view of the Kibo summit.
blocks.html: This morning the forest gives way to heather meadows and volcanic rock. You climb up and down through the green hills beneath the Shira Plateau, the third of Kilimanjaro’s volcanic peaks. When you reach the rim of the plateau, the long 5-6 hour walk is over and the path gets easier. You then arrive at Shira Camp for the night, with a wonderful view of the Kibo summit.

blocks.orig: Today’s hike lasts 7-8 hours and takes you from Heather into the alpine desert. You pass the Shira Plateau, one of the highest in the world, on the way to the Lava Tower, with an optional visit to the Shira Cathedral. From the Lava Tower, the path continues northwest toward Kibo, the highest peak of Kilimanjaro. Afterwards, you follow a steep trail to Moir Hut Camp, a remote spot with stunning views over the Shira Plateau.
blocks.html: Today’s walk takes 7-8 hours and leads you from the heather zone into alpine desert. On the way to the Lava Tower you cross the Shira Plateau, one of the highest in the world, and you can choose to visit the Shira Cathedral. Beyond the Lava Tower the trail heads northwest towards Kibo, Kilimanjaro's highest peak. You then take a steep path to Moir Hut Camp, an isolated place with beautiful views across the Shira Plateau.

blocks.orig: As you continue the route on the Northern Circuit, you get over a steep ridge along the main path. Today's hike lasts about 8 to 9 hours, taking you through heathland and alpine desert to Buffalo Camp. In the morning, you have the option to make a quick detour to Little Lent Hill.
blocks.html: Continuing along the Northern Circuit, you cross a steep ridge on the main trail. The walk today takes around 8 to 9 hours and leads through heathland and alpine desert to Buffalo Camp. In the morning you can choose to make a short detour to Little Lent Hill.

blocks.orig: On the fifth day on the mountain, you continue across diverse landscapes, including heathland, valleys, and alpine environments. The Northern Circuit route heads eastward and is less frequented, allowing for a peaceful experience of the scenery, wilderness, and stunning mountains. This trek takes approximately 5 to 7 hours.
blocks.html: On day five on the mountain, you keep walking through varied terrain, from heathland and valleys to alpine zones. The Northern Circuit route turns east here and sees fewer climbers, so you can enjoy the scenery, the wilderness and the beautiful mountains in peace. This part of the trek takes roughly 5 to 7 hours.

blocks.orig: Today involves a 4-5 hour climb to reach the "Saddle", a stunning lunar landscape between Mawenzi and Kibo Peaks. From there, you continue to School Hut Camp, arriving in the early afternoon. You have the rest of the day to relax and prepare for the final ascent the following day.
blocks.html: Today you climb for 4-5 hours to the "Saddle", a striking moon-like landscape between Mawenzi and Kibo Peaks. From there you carry on to School Hut Camp, which you reach in the early afternoon. The rest of the day is yours to rest and get ready for tomorrow's final climb.

blocks.orig: Around midnight, the summit push begins in the cold. Prepare for the steep path to Gilman’s Point, the rim of the main crater. After ascending for a few hours with short breaks, you reach Gilman’s Point to witness a breathtaking sunrise over Mawenzi Peak. Continue for 2-3 hours to Uhuru Peak, where you celebrate your success with incredible views. You then descend to Millenium Camp via Kibo Huts Camp, where you have dinner and spend your last night on the mountain.
blocks.html: At around midnight you start the push to the summit in the cold. Get ready for the steep trail to Gilman’s Point, on the rim of the main crater. After climbing for a few hours with short stops, you arrive at Gilman’s Point in time to see a stunning sunrise over Mawenzi Peak. Walk on for 2-3 hours to Uhuru Peak, where you celebrate your success with wonderful views. Afterwards you go down via Kibo Huts Camp to Millenium Camp, where you have dinner and spend your final night on the mountain.

blocks.orig: Finally, you appreciate the drop in altitude. After breakfast, you walk to the national park's exit. Following the descent, the group gathers to congratulate each other. Your driver takes you back to the hotel, where you enjoy a shower, a delicious dinner, and a well-deserved rest.
blocks.html: At last, you can enjoy the lower altitude. After breakfast you walk to the exit of the national park. Once down, the group comes together to congratulate one another. Your driver brings you back to the hotel for a shower, a tasty dinner and a well-earned rest.

blocks.orig: Sadly, this is the end of your holiday and the time to go home has arrived. Enjoy your last hours in Tanzania before our driver comes to pick you up and takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Still longing for more? It's also possible to add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
blocks.html: Unfortunately your holiday has come to an end and it is time to travel home. Make the most of your final hours in Tanzania until our driver collects you and brings you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight back. Want more? You can also combine your Kilimanjaro adventure with a few days of safari or a beach holiday!
